# ACT Creative

> ACT Creative Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based cross-border event fabrication and production partner. The company helps event agencies, brand activation teams, exhibition contractors and PR agencies deliver custom builds — props, scenic elements, FRP sculptures, exhibition booth components, branded merchandise — by combining Singapore-side coordination with China-side manufacturing across Yiwu, Dongguan, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Foshan, Shanghai and Suzhou.

ACT Creative serves clients across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Macau and mainland China. The team is bilingual (Mandarin and English), making it a natural production partner for Chinese brands launching in Southeast Asia and for SEA agencies sourcing in China.

- Legal name: ACT CREATIVE PTE. LTD.

## Core services

- [Event fabrication Singapore](https://actcreative.net/event-fabrication-singapore/): Custom fabrication for brand activations, exhibitions, launches, mall events and scenic displays in Singapore.
- [Custom props Singapore](https://actcreative.net/custom-props-singapore/): Bespoke props, oversized objects, themed decor and stage dressing for campaigns and events.
- [FRP sculpture fabrication Singapore](https://actcreative.net/frp-sculpture-fabrication-singapore/): FRP/fiberglass sculptures and installation pieces for retail, public art and themed environments.
- [Exhibition booth production Singapore](https://actcreative.net/exhibition-booth-production-singapore/): Booth structures, counters, signage, plinths, product displays and modular components.
- [China event production support](https://actcreative.net/china-event-production-support/): Supplier matching, factory coordination, sampling, quality checks and shipping for agencies running events in Singapore and SEA.
- [Event merchandise sourcing](https://actcreative.net/event-merchandise-sourcing/): Branded campaign giveaways, launch kits, press boxes and event utilities sourced from China.

## Case studies

- [A BIG BIG WORLD at Sentosa](https://actcreative.net/case-studies/sentosa-big-big-world-event-fabrication/): Singapore light show project with tens of thousands of visitors engaged. One of Singapore's largest floating balloon stage productions.
- [PACMAN and Friends at Sentosa](https://actcreative.net/case-studies/sentosa-pacman-human-game/): Themed public activation recorded by Singapore Book of Records.
- [Wings of Art Barbie Charity Art Exhibition](https://actcreative.net/case-studies/wings-of-art-barbie-runway-singapore/): Singapore props and event production for a charity art exhibition.

## Frequently asked

**Where is ACT Creative based and where does it deliver?**
ACT Creative is based in Singapore with production support across China. It delivers to Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, Hong Kong and Macau.

**What types of projects does ACT Creative take on?**
Custom event fabrication, props, exhibition booth components, FRP/sculpture, branded merchandise, brand activation setups and themed décor. Clients include event agencies, PR agencies, brand activation teams, exhibition contractors, retail and mall activation teams across Southeast Asia and Greater China.

**Can ACT Creative work with Chinese-speaking clients launching in Singapore?**
Yes. The team is bilingual (Mandarin and English). For Chinese brands launching events in Singapore or Southeast Asia, ACT Creative covers both the local Singapore execution side and China-side production in one workflow.

**Does ACT Creative serve only Singapore?**
Singapore is the primary base, but the team regularly handles projects across Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, Macau and the Greater Bay Area. The China supply chain spans Yiwu, Dongguan, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Foshan, Shanghai and Suzhou.

## How to engage

For a fabrication or sourcing brief, send drawings, reference images, target date and delivery location to contact@actcreative.net or WhatsApp +65 8451 5268. ACT Creative responds with a buildable specification, supplier shortlist or production plan within typical event timelines.
